hadith:
Partnership - Narrated Abu Musa:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the people of Ash`ari tribe ran short of food during the holy battles, or the food of their families in Medina ran short, they would collect all their remaining food in one sheet and then distribute it among themselves equally by measuring it with a bowl. So, these people are from me, and I am from them."
message: Allah is the One and Indivisible, sustaining all creation, and He responds to those who call upon Him with sincerity and need. Just as the companions of the Prophet ﷺ exemplified communal care by sharing their provisions equally during times of hardship, we too are called to trust in Allah's responsiveness while extending compassion to one another. Let this inspire you to turn to Al-Mujeeb, the Responder to Prayer, with faith that your sincere supplications will be heard, and to embody generosity toward others in their times of difficulty.
name:
Al Mujeeb  - الْمُجِيبُ - The Responder to Prayer

The name Al Mujeeb expresses Allah's attribute of responding to the supplications and needs of His creation. It emphasizes His willingness to answer prayers and grant requests, highlighting His mercy and compassion. The origin of this name is derived from Arabic, specifically from the root 'J-B', which relates to responding or answering. This name encourages believers to turn to Allah in their times of need, trusting in His responsiveness.
verse:
Al-Ikhlas - The Sincerity - 112:1-2

Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is Allah—One ˹and Indivisible˺; Allah—the Sustainer ˹needed by all˺.
